prompt: Vitrine search field for the museum site: the big query box in the home hero and at the top of search results.
shortDesc: Big search field for artworks, artists and subjects; submitting opens /search/<query>. Use it in exactly three places: inside the home page's g-feature-hero with no attributes (<g-search-box></g-search-box>), on the bare /search/ page (no query) with size="regular" and hide-label, since the section heading above already reads "Search the collections" (<g-search-box size="regular" hide-label></g-search-box>), and at the top of /search/<query> results with value set to the decoded query and size="regular" (<g-search-box value="water lilies" size="regular"></g-search-box>). Don't add it to other pages: the header already has a compact search. Fetches nothing.

props.name: value
props.description: Prefilled query: on /search/<query> the decoded segment, e.g. "water lilies" (%20 and + become spaces). Omit elsewhere.

props.name: size
props.description: large (default, 56px, serif input; use in the home hero) or regular (44px, sans input; use on both search pages, /search/ and /search/<query>).

props.name: hide-label
props.description: Present: the 'Search the collections' label is kept for screen readers only. Use it on the bare /search/ page, where the g-page-section heading already says the same; omit elsewhere.

styling.notes: form role=search with a visible small-caps 'Search the collections' label (--soft; screen-reader only with hide-label). A dark hero can recolour the label, focus ring and empty-query hint with --search-label, --search-ring and --search-hint. Paper input with a 1px rule border, a magnifier icon, and an oxblood border plus ring on focus-within. Large: Newsreader 20px, 56px tall; regular: Instrument Sans 16px, 44px. Solid oxblood .btn 'Search' that shows a spinner and 'Searching…' while navigating. Empty submit shows a polite hint instead of navigating. Full width up to 720px; stays one row on phones. Reduced motion stops the spinner and transitions.

markupSketch: — submit: trim, ignore empty, location.assign('/search/' + encodeURIComponent(q))
